detail.overview: Despite his family’s baffling generations-old ban on music, Miguel dreams of becoming an accomplished musician like his idol, Ernesto de la Cruz. Desperate to prove his talent, Miguel finds himself in the stunning and colorful Land of the Dead following a mysterious chain of events. Along the way, he meets charming trickster Hector, and together, they set off on an extraordinary journey to unlock the real story behind Miguel's family history.

results.overview: Several years after leaving the orphanage, to which her father never returned for her, Gabrielle Chanel finds herself working in a provincial bar. She's both a seamstress for the performers and a singer, earning the nickname Coco from the song she sings nightly with her sister. A liaison with Baron Balsan gives her an entree into French society and a chance to develop her gift for designing.
results.title: Coco Before Chanel

results.overview: After his father faces financial struggles, 12-year-old Max is forced to shut down the pawn shop he operates from his garage and move to a small country town. When Max discovers the world of small-scale farming, the young entrepreneur rallies the help of his cousin Charles, along with local youtuber Alice, to start an egg farming business in Charles's old decaying barn.
results.title: Coco Farm

results.overview: Fashion icon Coco Chanel, steeped in wealth and fame, still issues game-changing designs and collections. The audience is taken backwards in time to the woman's upbringing in an orphanage, and traces her path to ubiquity as it winds through poverty, wars, doomed romances, and rather glamorous betrayals.
results.title: Coco Chanel

results.overview: In this short documentary Netherlands filmmaker Lara Verheijden stages an insight into her childhood friend Coco's life at home. At the beginning of the documentary Coco is due to give birth in a week. Over the course of this week, filmmaker and friend dismantle the old ideas of pregnancy's traditional joys and look to individualize the/a mother's experience.
results.title: Coco

results.overview: Three years after Miguel Rivera risked everything to bring harmony back to his family, the teenager has been filling the streets of Santa Cecilia with his music. But on the eve of an important audition, Miguel's dreams are threatened when Ernesto de la Cruz - the fallen idol who won't stay forgotten - returns for a vengeful encore. Miguel travels back to the Land of the Dead to reclaim the one thing he cannot live without, and learns that this time it will take more than a song to save what matters most.
results.title: Coco 2

results.overview: 13 year old Coco loves fashion and has her own unique style. She dreams of becoming a famous fashion icon. But on her first day of school she is made fun of and everyone calls her 'Coco the Clown'. Devastated, she decides to leave her vintage dresses, panther boots and striped socks at home and to dress herself more unnoticeable. Her anonymously kept fashion vlog as Style Tiger is a huge hit however. Is there still a chance that she will become a style icon? And does Bruno, that quirky boy she knows from school and secretly likes, finally notice her? Slowly Coco learns that she just has to be 100% herself!
results.title: 100% Coco

results.overview: Released from prison, Zhanbolat, in an attempt to improve his life, returns to old habits — stealing. Under ridiculous circumstances, he meets the talented artist Corlan. By the will of fate, Zhanbolat undertakes to help her with the exhibition, finds an artist's talent. The preparation for the exhibition brings two young people closer, but Zhanbolat has to live a double life: a thief and an artist.
results.title: Coco & Janbo

results.title: Cocoanut

results.overview: Pleun from Rotterdam has been running Casa Coco, a guest house for reflection and rest on Bonaire, for years. The Rotterdam people from her own circle of acquaintances like to come over for a wonderful holiday together. This autumn, Pleun's childhood sweetheart Toon comes along with a befriended couple after his wife announces she wants to divorce him, to make him forget his problems under the Antillean sun. The two ex-lovers have not seen each other for years. Because Pleun left Toon out of the blue fifty years ago and went to Bonaire, Toon falls back from one problem to another.
results.title: Casa Coco

results.overview: After an 18-year hiatus from acting, Sherihan returns to the stage to portray Coco Chanel, the renowned French fashion designer and style icon.
results.title: Coco Chanel

results.overview: A powerful journey of an Irish mother who lost her daughter, Nicole (Coco) to suicide and her mission to change the law in Ireland and the EU to make online bullying a crime while also fighting to have the law named after her daughter.
results.title: Jackie & Coco
